content: Vivekachudamani: Just as a pot is nothing other than clay, so is the entire universe nothing other than Brahman.
author: Adi Shankara
explanation: Forms are diverse naming and conditioning of a single underlying substance. The universe of names and forms is simply consciousness taking infinite shapes without ever departing from its intrinsic nature.
practicalInsight: Look around your physical room right now and recognize that all objects, thoughts, and feelings are manifestations appearing within one field of awareness.
reflectionPrompt: Can I look past the temporary labels of my experience to see the uniform reality supporting them all?
